31.name: Subway
31.goal: Help her figure out what's strange

steps.what: Drag the demon poster onto the window to cover the ghost
steps.why: Live-verified: tapping the ghost does nothing — you must drag the creepy poster from the wall over the window (cut it loose with the backpack scissors first if it won't move). Tape from the backpack also covers the window.

steps.what: Drag the woman's coat onto the blood-red liquid
steps.why: Live-verified: the red puddle on the floor only reacts when you drag her coat over it. Tapping the puddle does nothing.

steps.what: Swipe down the wobbling ring, swipe down the teddy bear, then fix the ceiling panel
steps.why: Live-verified: the hanging strap reacts to a downward swipe. The teddy bear in the bottom-right corner swipes down too — it opens a battery compartment. Open the toolbox and drag the nails and hammer onto the loose ceiling panel above.

steps.what: Throw the high heels at the static TV, spray the under-seat area, then hand over the phone
steps.why: The heels fix the snowy TV. Drag the fire extinguisher to the area under the floor to deal with what is hiding there. Only once the carriage calms down does the phone get signal — drag the phone to the girl to trigger the dream-ending. Dragging it earlier does nothing.
